meaning_en: the rate rises most from level {after} to level {level} ({change})
meaning_zh: 转化率从层级 {after} 到层级 {level} 升幅最大（{change}）

meaning_en: all {windows} windows put the cut at level {level}
meaning_zh: {windows} 个窗口都把切分点放在层级 {level}

meaning_en: the windows do not agree on the cut ({cuts})
meaning_zh: 各窗口对切分点的判断不一致（{cuts}）

meaning_en: no clear cut: none of the {steps} steps with data rises with an interval above zero
meaning_zh: 没有明确的切分点：{steps} 个有数据的台阶没有一个的区间整体在零之上

meaning_en: no cut can be read: no two consecutive levels both have eligible customers ({levels} levels)
meaning_zh: 无法判断切分点：没有相邻两层同时有符合条件的客户（共 {levels} 层）
